description: This Java class extends DeviceAdminReceiver to handle events related to managed profile provisioning on Android devices. It includes logic to launch an activity upon profile setup completion and to provide a ComponentName for the receiver.

classes.name: EnforcerDeviceAdminReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that manages events related to device administration, specifically handling profile provisioning completion.

methods.name: onProfileProvisioningComplete
methods.description: Triggered when a managed profile has been provisioned; launches EnableProfileActivity.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Returns a ComponentName representing this DeviceAdminReceiver.
